title: 第15章 荒山艳鬼冻手冻手第16章 斩杀女鬼功德到手
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
只见一男子无精打采，打着哈欠。
往义庄方向前行。
青年男子的脚步轻飘飘的。
仿佛脚下无力，总是难以找到稳定的节奏。
走路间好似都失去了所有力气。
怕是一阵强风都能将其吹倒。
过道之人不是别人，正是秋生。
正当眼神有所交集处。
三人有所感应一般，不约而同的望向对方。
忽的大眼瞪小眼。
顷刻间秋生像挪不开步一般，再难动半分。
尴尬的呆呆站在原地。
九叔提眉一皱，气息流转。
此刻正感应着，秋生混乱的气息！
“有问题！”
九叔心里暗道。
秋生阳气失去大半，不怪的整个人都如此颓废。
两眼无神，精神萎靡，昏昏欲睡。
四肢软绵无力，精气神尽失。
定是昨夜被妖怪迷了眼。

得亏人没事。
九叔沉下心，却也没开口，望向林凡示意。
林凡瞬间了然于心，怎么也是个拥有大圆满开眼术的人。
怎看的也是一清二楚。
“秋生，你直接说，还是我直接问？”
林凡嘴角上扬，稍有鄙夷的说道。
“大……大师兄，说，说什么啊。”
秋生假装无事发生一般答道。
林凡见状便一针见血回道：“说你昨晚去了哪里。”
只见秋生两眼珠急转向上，食指半指向上空。
仿佛正在构思着某件事情。
嘴巴已然张开，却迟迟开不了口。
“好了，你进去任府大堂随文才一起布置。”
“好的，师父。”
九叔话音一出，秋生闻言见缝插针。
一把穿过两人奔向任府大堂内。
content_en:
I saw a man listless and yawning.
Go towards Yizhuang.
The young man's steps were light and graceful.
It seems that my feet are weak and it is always difficult to find a stable rhythm.
It seemed like I had lost all my strength while walking.
I'm afraid a strong wind could blow it down.
The person in the aisle was none other than Qiu Sheng.
Just when their eyes met.
The three of them looked at each other in unison as if they were sensing something.
Suddenly big eyes stared at small eyes.
In an instant, Qiu Sheng seemed unable to move even an inch.
He stood there awkwardly.
Uncle Jiu raised his eyebrows and frowned, his breath flowing.
At this moment, I am sensing Qiu Sheng’s chaotic aura!
"There's a problem!"
Uncle Jiu thought to himself.
Qiu Sheng had lost most of his yang energy, so it was no wonder that his whole person was so decadent.
His eyes were dull, his energy was listless, and he was drowsy.
My limbs are limp and my energy and energy are gone.
He must have been bewitched by a monster last night.
It's okay to lose someone.
Uncle Jiu calmed down, but did not speak. He looked at Lin Fan to signal.
Lin Fan instantly understood that he was also a person with the Dzogchen Eye-Opening Skill.
It’s clear how to see it.
"Qiusheng, do you tell me directly, or should I ask directly?"
Lin Fan raised the corners of his mouth and said with a slight disdain.
"Senior... senior brother, tell me, what are you talking about?"
Qiu Sheng replied as if nothing happened.
Lin Fan saw this and replied sharply: "Tell me where you went last night."
Qiu Sheng's eyes turned upwards and his index finger was half pointing upward.
It seems that he is thinking about something.
The mouth is already open, but it still can't open.
"Okay, you go into the lobby of Ren Mansion and arrange it with Wen Cai."
"Okay, Master."
As soon as Uncle Jiu's words came out, Qiu Sheng took every opportunity to make mistakes.
He passed through the two of them and ran towards the lobby of Ren Mansion.
